message.content:
**Signers of the United States Declaration of Independence (July 4, 1776)**  

| State | Signers (in order of appearance on the original parchment) |
|-------|-----------------------------------------------------------|
| **Delaware** | Thomas McKean, George Read, Caesar Rodney |
| **Pennsylvania** | George Clymer, Benjamin Franklin, Robert Morris, John Morton, George Taylor, James Smith |
| **New Jersey** | William Franklin, John Hart, Francis Hopkinson, John Witherspoon |
| **Georgia** | Button Gwinnett, Lyman Hall, George Walton |
| **Connecticut** | Roger Sherman, Samuel Huntington, William Williams, Oliver Wolcott |
| **Massachusetts** | John Adams, Samuel Adams, John Hancock, Joseph Warren, Paul Revere, John Hancock (duplicate entry in some lists) |
| **Maryland** | Charles Carroll, Samuel Chase, William Paca, Thomas Stone, Charles Carroll of Carrollton |
| **South Carolina** | Edward Rutledge, Thomas Heyward Jr., William Hooper, James Wilson |
| **New Hampshire** | Josiah Bartlett, William Whipple, Matthew Thornton |
| **Virginia** | George Wythe, Richard Henry Lee, Thomas Jefferson, Benjamin Harrison, Thomas Jefferson (duplicate) |
| **New York** | William Floyd, Philip Livingston, Francis Lewis, Lewis Morris |
| **North Carolina** | William Hooper, Joseph Hewes, John Penn |
| **Rhode Island** | Stephen Hopkins, William Ellery, Roger Williams |
| **New York** | (already listed above) |

> **Total:** 56 signers.

> **Key figures**  
> • **Thomas Jefferson** – Principal author of the Declaration.  
> • **John Adams** – Strong advocate for independence, later the second U.S. President.  
> • **Benjamin Franklin** – Renowned statesman and diplomat.  
> • **John Hancock** – Famous for his large signature on the document.  

---

### Quick Reference

- **Event:** Declaration of Independence  
- **Date:** July 4, 1776  
- **Location:** Philadelphia, Pennsylvania  
- **Time Period:** American Revolution  

If you’d like the exact date or more details about the event itself, let me know and I can fetch that information for you!
